translations.title: Acetaminophen 650 mg Tablet
translations.efficacy: This medicine is used to reduce fever and to ease pain from a cold, headache, toothache, muscle pain, back pain, period pain and joint pain.
translations.usage: Adults and children 12 or older take two tablets every 8 hours. Do not take more than six tablets in 24 hours. This is a slow-release tablet, so swallow it whole — do not crush or chew it. Do not take it together with other cold or pain medicines that contain acetaminophen.
translations.caution: Do not take this if you have ever reacted to it, if you have a peptic ulcer, a severe blood disorder, severe liver or kidney problems, severe heart failure, aspirin-induced asthma, or if you are under 12. If you are pregnant or breastfeeding, or are elderly, talk to a pharmacist before taking it. If you drink alcohol regularly there is a risk of liver damage, so get advice, and do not take more than 4,000 mg a day. If a rash, blisters or other signs of a hypersensitivity reaction appear after taking it, stop immediately and talk to a pharmacist or doctor. Talk to a pharmacist or doctor if a fever lasts more than 3 days or pain more than 10 days.
